source_contract: Fixed stability2024.pdf physical page 17 was directly viewed. Its perfect split has the two actual omission orbits, a single crossing transposition, and the stated one-sided support of every other mark. No implication from a projected action to actual IP is assumed.
mathematical_review: Faithful restriction of each actually supported wing preserves its full subgroup lattice; the two omission orbits make each wing transitive. Commutation of every nonadjacent wing mark with the crossing mark forces the attachment point fixed, whereas transitivity forces the nearest mark to move it. The split factor on the wing lies in the anchored suffix centralizer.

Complete L047 transitive classification was checked at its actual hypotheses. The uniform odd wreath equality proof gives lambda and lambda+e_j before any cocycle automorphism; every point is moved by lambda, any candidate unique-mover point lies in block j, and a transitive block generator moves it too. This does not incorrectly transport anchor data through an abstract automorphism.

The finite L047 exception roster is exactly fourteen imprimitive tuples plus the primitive degree-six rank-four S5 tuple. Both orientations were checked. All thirty anchor sets are empty. The lower primitive exceptions are at half degree and do not enter the argument.

Complete L044 alternating rank theorem leaves only natural A5 rank three and A11 rank six above half degree. A5 involutions have a unique fixed point, which any commuting involution fixes; this excludes the proposed endpoint anchor without finite sampling.

All four actual A11 rank-six tuples were re-extracted from the full acquired census. Both orientations yield precisely four nonempty anchor cases. The equivariant-map recursion tries every possible image of each new orbit, and injectivity plus mark propagation is both necessary and sufficient for a centralizing bijection. Every anchored centralizer is trivial.

Literal finite closure and a separate GAP calculation give end orders 5040 and 5040, intersection 360 and middle 60 in each case. The obstruction uses index six, not merely the failure of one arbitrary quotient marking. Since alpha=1, the actual attachment embeds in the pure attached group times the disjoint involution beta, with central projection kernel of order at most two.

The acquired central-difference homomorphism applies to these actual maximal ends. If the actual five-mark subfamily had IP, the downstairs intersection modulo the common-middle image would embed in a quotient of that central kernel. Its index six is incompatible. The argument includes beta=1 and uses no projected IP assumption.

The final inequality adds the two actual wing ranks, r-1<=n/2. Singletons are handled separately as full symmetric groups. No perfect-split existence, extension/contraction bijection, eventual counting constant or whole L019 result is inferred.
